name: Speedo Short Blade training fin
description: The core short-blade job for less money. Not as refined as the Zoomer or as plush as the Arena, but a reasonable, low-risk way to try fin work — or to outfit a kid who'll grow out of them by spring.

name: TYR Catalyst swim paddles
description: A power-builder's paddle — clear size options, a contoured shape, and adjustable straps that hold securely for heavy pull sets with a buoy. For experienced swimmers with solid technique who want to load the catch.

name: Budget waterproof bone-conduction MP3 headphones
description: The low-risk way to find out whether you like swimming to music. Confirm real onboard storage and an IPX8 rating before you buy, then upgrade later if you get hooked.

name: DMC Elite training fins
description: The elite-deck fin. A slightly longer, angled blade rewards a strong, technically sound kick with serious propulsion for underwater dolphin work.
